items.title: File Widerspruch against refusal of Brauchtumsfeuer permit
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie innerhalb eines Monats nach seiner Bekanntgabe schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Behörde: Amt Musterschlei, Am Markt 6, 24376 Musterkappeln.
items.computation: Letter dated Wed 18.11.2026, sent by ordinary post. Per § 110 Abs. 2 LVwG SH, a decision sent by simple letter is deemed delivered (Bekanntgabe) on the 4th day after posting: 18.11.2026 + 4 days = Sun 22.11.2026. This fiction fixes the date of deemed knowledge and is not itself a procedural deadline, so the weekend-shift rule of § 193 BGB does not apply to it; Bekanntgabe therefore stands on 22.11.2026. The one-month Widerspruchsfrist then runs under §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB: the day of Bekanntgabe (22.11.) is not counted, the period begins 23.11.2026, and a month-period ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the day of the triggering event (22.), i.e. 22.12.2026. 22.12.2026 is a Tuesday, not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in Schleswig-Holstein, so no further shift under § 193 BGB is needed.
